list.text: Yo! Champ in the making!
This Gym is home to Normal-type Pokémon Trainers.
I recommend you use Fighting-type Pokémon.
You won? Great! I was busy admiring the powerful Trainers here.
Give it your best shot, or I'll take you down!
I taught MEOWTH moves for taking on any type...
Oh, you're a cute little Trainer!\nI like you, but I won't hold back!
Wow, you must be good to beat me!\nKeep it up!
You shouldn't let your guard down just 'cause I don't look tough!
Who do you think are stronger--boys or girls?
I like cute Pokémon better than strong Pokémon.
But I have strong and cute Pokémon!
I'm training really hard to try to beat Whitney, but I'm starting to get discouraged...
What to do...\nWell... If I lose, I'll just try harder next time!
\f[whitney]\c[5]Hi! Im' Whitney!
\f[whitney]\c[5]...You!\nI saw you at the Radio Tower just now.
\f[whitney]\c[5]Everyone was into Pokémon, so I got into it, too!
\f[whitney]\c[5]Pokémon are super cute!
\f[whitney]\c[5]You want to battle?
\f[whitney]\c[5]I'm warning you--I'm good!
\f[whitney]\c[5]Waaaaah!
\f[whitney]\c[5]Waaaaah!
\f[whitney]\c[5]...Snivel, hic.\n...You meanie!
\f[whitney]\c[5]...Sniff...
\f[whitney]\c[5]What? What do you want? A Badge?
\f[whitney]\c[5]Oh, right. I forgot.\nHere's the Plain badge.
\PN received the Plain Badge from Whitney.
\f[whitney]\c[5]The Plain Badge lets your Pokemon use Rock Smash outside of battle.
\f[whitney]\c[5]Oh, you can have this, too!

then.text: \f[whitney]\c[5]It's Attract!\nIt makes full use of a Pokémon's charm.
\f[whitney]\c[5]Isn't it just perfect for a cutie like me? \nThat's right!

list.text: \f[whitney]\c[5]Ah, that was a good cry!

then.text: \f[whitney]\c[5]I'm feeling good now, let's take a photo together then!

list.text: \f[whitney]\c[5]Hi \PN!\nAre you making good use of the Z-Power Ring that I gave to you?
\f[whitney]\c[5]I'll be forever grateful for your help in kicking Team Rocket out of town
\f[whitney]Whitney: \c[5]What a coincidence!\nI was just thinking about you!
\f[whitney]\c[5]Yeah, I'm bored! Nothing to do!\nOh, yeah!\nYou wanna battle me again?

then.text: \f[whitney]Whitney: \c[5]You really are strong!\nBut I won't lose next time!
\f[whitney]\c[5]This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Normal-type moves to Z-Moves.
\f[whitney]\c[5]I'll be watching you for sure in the World Cup, \PN!\nGood luck!

list.text: \f[whitney]\c[5]Ah, that was a good battle!
\f[whitney]\c[5]Come for a visit again! Bye-bye!
Oh, no. You made Whitney cry.
It's OK. She'll stop soon.\nShe always cries when she loses.
